steps.code:
# Compute sets of emails
phone_friend_emails = {f['email'] for f in phone_friends}
venmo_friend_emails = {f['email'] for f in venmo_friends}

# Friends to add (in phone but not in venmo)
to_add = phone_friend_emails - venmo_friend_emails
# Friends to remove (in venmo but not in phone)
to_remove = venmo_friend_emails - phone_friend_emails

print("To add:", to_add)
print("To remove:", to_remove)

# Add missing friends
for email in to_add:
    resp = apis.venmo.add_friend(access_token=venmo_token, user_email=email)
    print(f"Added {email}: {resp}")

# Remove extra friends
for email in to_remove:
    resp = apis.venmo.remove_friend(access_token=venmo_token, user_email=email)
    print(f"Removed {email}: {resp}")
